title_en: Regulations on the Work of Local Chronicles

articles.content_en: Article 1 These Regulations are formulated for the purpose of inheriting and carrying forward the fine cultural traditions of the Chinese nation, compiling local chronicles in a comprehensive, objective and systematic manner, scientifically and rationally developing and utilizing local chronicles, and giving play to the role of local chronicles in promoting economic and social development.
Article 2 These Regulations shall apply to the organization, compilation, management, development and utilization of local chronicles within the territory of the People's Republic of China.

Article 3 For the purposes of these Regulations, local chronicles include local chronicle books and local comprehensive yearbooks.
Local chronicle books mean documentary materials that comprehensively and systematically record the history and current situation of the nature, politics, economy, culture and society of the administrative region.
Local comprehensive yearbooks mean annual documentary materials that systematically record the nature, politics, economy, culture, society and other aspects of the administrative region.
Local chronicles are divided into: local chronicles compiled by provinces (autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government), local chronicles compiled by cities with districts (autonomous prefectures), and local chronicles compiled by counties (autonomous counties, cities without districts, municipal districts).

Article 4 Local people's governments at or above the county level shall strengthen the leadership over local chronicles work within their respective administrative regions. The funds required for local chronicles work shall be included in the fiscal budget at the corresponding level.

Article 6 The compilation of local chronicles shall adhere to truthfulness, ensure quality, and comprehensively and objectively record the history and current situation of the nature, politics, economy, culture and society of the administrative region.

Article 7 The people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall formulate the overall work plan (hereinafter referred to as the plan) for the compilation of local chronicles within their respective administrative regions, and submit it to the national guiding institution for local chronicles work for recordation.

Article 8 Local chronicle books and local comprehensive yearbooks prefixed with the name of a county or above administrative region shall be compiled under the plan by the local chronicles work institution of the people's government at the corresponding level; no other organization or individual may compile them.

Article 9 Experts and scholars from relevant fields shall be invited to participate in the compilation of local chronicles. The compilation personnel of local chronicles shall consist of both full-time and part-time staff, and full-time compilation personnel shall possess corresponding professional knowledge.

Article 10 Local chronicle books shall be compiled and revised approximately every 20 years. After each round of compilation and revision of local chronicle books is completed, the institution responsible for local chronicles work shall initiate the continuation work for the next round while compiling local comprehensive yearbooks, collecting materials and providing consulting services to the public.

Article 11 The local chronicles work institution of the local people's government at or above the county level may collect relevant local chronicle materials from state organs, social organizations, enterprises, public institutions, other organizations and individuals, and the relevant entities and individuals shall provide support. The institution responsible for local chronicles work may consult, extract and copy relevant materials, except those involving State secrets, trade secrets and personal privacy, or those not meeting the conditions for disclosure of archives.
The owner or holder of local chronicle materials may receive appropriate compensation for providing relevant materials. The owner or holder of local chronicle materials shall not intentionally provide false materials.

Article 12 Local chronicle books prefixed with the name of a county or above administrative region and included in the plan may be publicly published only after being examined and accepted.
For the examination and acceptance of local chronicle books, experts in confidentiality, archives, history, law, economy, military and other relevant fields shall be organized to participate, focusing on examining whether the content of the local chronicle books complies with the provisions of the Constitution and laws and regulations on confidentiality, archives, etc., and whether it comprehensively and objectively reflects the history and current situation of the nature, politics, economy, culture and society of the administrative region.
The subject, procedures, etc. for the examination and acceptance of local chronicle books shall be prescribed by the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government.

Article 13 Local comprehensive yearbooks prefixed with the name of a county or above administrative region may be publicly published only after being approved by the people's government at the corresponding level or the department designated by it.

Article 14 Local chronicles shall be submitted to the local chronicles work institution of the people's government at the next higher level for recordation within three months after publication.
The textual materials, charts, photos, audio-visual materials, physical objects, etc. collected during the compilation of local chronicles, as well as the manuscripts of local chronicles formed, shall be managed centrally and uniformly by full-time personnel designated by the local chronicles work institution of the people's government at the corresponding level, and be properly preserved without damage; after the compilation work is completed, they shall be transferred according to law to the national archives at the corresponding level or the local chronicles museum for preservation and management, and no individual may take them as his own or lease, sell or lend them.

Article 15 Local chronicle books and local comprehensive yearbooks prefixed with the name of a county or above administrative region are works made in the course of employment. In accordance with the provisions of Article 16, paragraph 2 of the Copyright Law of the People's Republic of China, the copyright in such works shall be enjoyed by the local chronicles work institution that organized the compilation, and the personnel participating in the compilation shall enjoy the right of authorship.

Article 16 The local chronicles work shall serve the comprehensive economic and social development of the local area. The local chronicles work institution of the local people's government at or above the county level shall actively explore ways for the society to use the chronicles, and may strengthen the informatization construction of local chronicles work by building databases, websites and the like. Citizens, legal persons and other organizations may use the aforesaid databases and websites to consult and extract local chronicles.

Article 17 Local people's governments at or above the county level shall give commendations and awards to units and individuals that have made outstanding achievements and contributions in the local chronicles work.

Article 18 Whoever, in violation of the provisions of these Regulations, compiles and publishes without authorization local chronicle books or local comprehensive yearbooks prefixed with the name of a county or above administrative region, the local chronicles work institution of the local people's government at or above the county level shall request the publication administration department of the people's government at the corresponding level to investigate and punish according to law.

Article 19 Whoever, in violation of the provisions of these Regulations, delivers the manuscript of local chronicles for publication without examination, acceptance or approval, or where the local chronicles contain content that violates the provisions of the Constitution, laws or regulations, the people's government at the next higher level or the people's government at the corresponding level shall order the adoption of corresponding measures to rectify the situation, and investigate the liability of the relevant units and individuals depending on the seriousness of the circumstances; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 20 Where a staff member of the local chronicles work institution violates the provisions of Article 14, paragraph 2 of these Regulations, the unit to which he belongs shall order him to make corrections, and impose a sanction according to law.

Article 21 Where the compilation of local chronicles involves military content, the relevant provisions of the Central Military Commission on the compilation of military chronicles shall also be complied with.
The compilation of departmental chronicles of the State Council shall be carried out by reference to the relevant provisions of these Regulations.
Article 22 These Regulations shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
